t: What he said facing an army
a: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، وَمُجْرِيَ السَّحَابِ، وَهَازِمَ الأَحْزَابِ، اهْزِمْهُمْ وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ
p: Allāhumma munzila-l-kitāb, wa mujriya-s-saḥāb, wa hāzima-l-aḥzāb, ihzimhum wa-nṣurnā ʿalayhim
m: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Mover of the clouds, Defeater of the armies, defeat them and help us against them.
